notes:
ScreenTale 1.24.0 makes it easier to try every feature for free before you decide to buy.

- If you have not bought ScreenTale or used your Launch Pass yet, Settings › License now starts with a Try ScreenTale Free for 30 Days card. Start the 30-day Launch Pass for full-quality exports without a watermark, or buy a lifetime license from the same card. No payment method is needed for the Launch Pass.
- After you finish granting permissions, ScreenTale invites you once to start your Launch Pass. Choose Not Now, Buy Lifetime License or Start 30-Day Launch Pass.
- Upgrade in the Editor now offers the Launch Pass first while it is still available to you, with Buy Lifetime License in the same dialog.
- If your Launch Pass has already ended, ScreenTale now says so and offers Buy Lifetime License instead of showing a connection error.
